title: Product Planning — Q4 Roadmap
summary: Product reviewed candidate themes for the Q4 roadmap. The group aligned on three bets: onboarding activation, a self-serve billing portal, and mobile performance. Self-serve billing was ranked highest because it unblocks the sales team. Sofia raised that mobile performance needs research before it can be scoped. The decision was to commit to billing and onboarding for Q4 and keep mobile performance as a stretch pending a research spike.

chapter_summaries.title: Choosing the Q4 Themes
chapter_summaries.description: Dana presented three candidate themes: onboarding activation, self-serve billing, and mobile performance. James argued self-serve billing is the highest-leverage bet because it unblocks stalled sales deals, and Priya noted billing is well understood on the engineering side.

chapter_summaries.title: Commitments and the Mobile Research Spike
chapter_summaries.description: Sofia flagged that mobile performance can't be scoped until its slowness is understood, so the group committed billing and onboarding for Q4 and kept mobile as a stretch pending a one-week research spike.

Sofia Martins will run a one-week research spike on mobile performance.
James Okafor will share the Q4 commitments with the sales team.
key_questions: Which Q4 bet unblocks revenue fastest?
Is mobile performance a scoping problem or a research problem?
